desc: Versatile semi-automatic shotgun with synthetic pistol grip stock in Woodland camouflage. LPA front sight and rear ghost ring sight mounted on a Picatinny rail. Active Valve gas operation. Invector-Plus choke tubes. From running a 3-gun competition course to hunting turkey to just keeping handy when camping in the woods, the biggest feature of the SX4 Extreme Defender shotgun is versatility.
